3. Read what comes back: Works out the codes exactly as tool:work-out-referral-codes does, from the person's own referral reward rules, then writes what the rules give as the records the existing tools already read.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:referral-reward-rule (records:list); checkout-code-adjustment (records:read, records:write); access-grant (records:read, records:write).
